description: This file defines the TargetBuilder interface, which provides a fluent API for constructing instances of the Target class, allowing configuration of properties such as address, qos, authorizationContext, topics, acknowledgement labels, header and payload mappings.

classes.name: TargetBuilder
classes.description: An interface providing a fluent API to construct and configure Target instances with various settings such as address, topics, acknowledgment labels, and other properties.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Sets the address property of the target.

methods.name: qos
methods.description: Sets the Quality of Service level for the target.

methods.name: authorizationContext
methods.description: Sets the authorization context associated with the target.

methods.name: topics
methods.description: Sets the set of FilteredTopic objects for the target.

methods.name: topics
methods.description: Sets multiple FilteredTopics, either via an array or a varargs parameter.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the configured Target instance.
